title: Security hardening: rate limiting, distance checks, data copy, bulk limits
description: Comprehensive server-side security hardening including attack rate limiting with distance checks, central rate limiter for all remotes, campaign duplicate deploy prevention, client data copy function, and bulk delete size limits.
steps: Add attack rate limiting and distance check to ZoneService.attackDestructible
Add per-pet damage tracking (AssignPetTarget) to ZoneService
Add click attack rate limiting and distance check to ZoneService.clickAttackDestructible
Add central rate limiter to Main.server.lua with per-action cooldowns
Add duplicate pet deploy prevention to CampaignService.deployPet
Add getClientData function to DataService that returns a sanitized copy
Update GetPlayerData handler to use getClientData
Add bulk delete size limit (100) to DeletePets handler
acceptance_criteria: AttackDestructible only counts pets assigned to the target
Central rate limiter applied to all specified remotes
Campaign deployPet rejects duplicate pet instance IDs
GetPlayerData returns a sanitized copy not the cache reference
DeletePets rejects more than 100 pet IDs
Rate limit entries cleaned up on player removal
findings: Network mode is INTEGRATIONS_ONLY - pure Luau project, no external dependencies needed
ZoneService attack rate limiting uses os.clock() for precise sub-second timing
Pet target fallback ensures backwards compatibility: if no pets assigned to target, all equipped pets are used
DataService.getClientData uses deepCopy already defined in the module
CampaignService duplicate check placed before energy deduction to prevent wasted energy on rejected deploys
